messages:
maya (PM): kicking off a quick thread to lock acceptance criteria for the customer bakeoff on Optimize Toolkit (batching/caching/quant + eval-triggered alerts). need concrete, testable gates we can share with customers and sales by EOD tomorrow.

sam (eng): +1. would help to separate infra SLOs from quality metrics. infra: latency/cost; quality: eval deltas, false positive rate for alerts.

lina (ml): posting proposed quality gates i pulled from pilot notes: 1) no >3% drop in top-1 accuracy (or equivalent metric per task) vs baseline model on customer eval set; 2) alert precision >= 70% and recall >= 60% for regression alerts during pilot; 3) rolling window min samples = 50.

jordan (se): for batching/cache/quant recommendations we should require: cost reduction >=15% for steady workloads, and p95 latency increase <= 20% (absolute cap of 250ms additional). customers will reject anything that regresses perceived responsiveness.

ana? i mean ana (cs): spelling out customer acceptance behavior: if we produce an actionable recommendation, CS must be able to link it to a config change request and measure before/after within 2 weeks. also require a customer opt-in consent step for any automated rollout.

maya (PM): good. propose we categorize gates: MVP (hard gates) and Nice-to-have (soft). hard: no >3% quality drop, alert precision >=70%, cost reduction >=10% (MVP lower bar), p95 latency delta <= 200ms. soft: automated rollback, per-route guidance UI.

sam (eng): technical note: quantization will have model-specific variance. suggest we allow model-specific thresholds and require we surface confidence intervals in the report. for infra SLOs, we add: 99th percentile token time <= Xms per GPU type (we can fill numbers per runbook).

lina (ml): agree on model-specific thresholds. also: eval-triggered alert spec draft ->

```yaml
alert_name: eval_regression_v1
metric: customer_defined_metric # e.g., exact_match / rouge / custom scorer
baseline_window: 7d
compare_window: 24h
threshold: -3.0 # percent drop
min_samples: 50
min_affected_routes: 1
actions:
  - notify: # slack channel to CS and SE
      channels: [#cs-oncall, #se-optimization]
  - tag_model: canary
  - optional: rollback_canary
```

jordan (se): that YAML is super helpful. add severity levels (info/warn/critical) based on magnitude and impacted traffic. also include a cooldown window to avoid noisy flapping.

ana? ana (cs): for the bakeoff ask the customers to provide 3 canonical eval prompts + production sample traffic distribution. we'll run comparisons on both. acceptance requires both the eval set gate and no customer-visible latency regressions on sampled traffic.

maya (PM): negotiation point: sales asked for an "auto-recommend" mode that will push config changes. ops + security pushed back. proposal: not in MVP. MVP = recommendations + checklist + one-click apply (manual confirmation). auto-apply relegated to future phase.

sam (eng): +1 to manual apply. also want a feature flag for 'one-click apply' per-customer with audit logs. rollout plan: canary to internal, then 2 pilot customers (AcmeChat, FinServe), then broad beta.

lina (ml): pilot metrics we should capture and share: pre/post cost per 1M tokens, p95 latency, quality metric delta, alert precision/recall, number of false positives per week. suggest csv export for customer reports.

jordan (se): owner assignments: infra SLOs -> sam; eval alert logic & dashboards -> lina; customer onboarding flow & docs -> ana; rollout gating & metrics -> maya.

maya (PM): raising timeline: target pilot sign-ups this month, pilot runs 3 weeks each, decision gate after combined results. can we ship an internal alpha next week?

sam (eng): we can cut a minimal alpha: recommendation engine + static report + eval-alert simulator. no UI, just API + example notebook. expect ~5 dev days.

deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled: optimize-toolkit-alpha -> cluster-prod-canary @ 2023-11-08T16:30Z :rocket:

ana? ana (cs): i'll reach out to two pilot customers today and surface the acceptance criteria doc. tagging @sam and @lina for technical Qs during onboarding.

maya (PM): thanks all. action items: sam creates alpha branch & rough runbook (due in 3d), lina publishes alert config templates + evaluation script (due 2d), ana starts customer outreach (today). i'll assemble a one-page acceptance checklist for sales. will post final checklist here when ready. :thumbsup:
